items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1960-11-03
items.q: What did you get over there with Kevin?

ctx.x: Did you ever lead your own band, Pete? Huh? Did you ever have a band of your own? Did you ever lead your own band?
Oh, yes. I see. What did you get over there with Kevin?
Still had a little bit. They didn't have a band. What did you talk? It's great.
